# Runbook: patient identifier validation (`pid-validate` stage)
Owner: Clinical Data Engineering · Page last edited 2026-09-30 by ⟦name|Farah Iqbal⟧ · v3.2

## Purpose
`pid-validate` normalises and checks every patient identifier arriving from GP extracts, the referrals feed and the two Canadian partner sites before records are linked. It never looks identifiers up against a live register; it only checks shape and check digit.

## Supported identifiers
| Identifier | Normalised shape | Check | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| NHS number (England, Wales, IoM) | 10 digits, shown `nnn nnn nnnn` | Modulus 11, weights 10→2; remainder 10 ⇒ invalid | numbers starting 999 are the test range |
| CHI number (Scotland) | 10 digits, `DDMMYY` + 4 | Modulus 11 as NHS; 9th digit odd = male | do not use the date part as a DOB source |
| H&C number (Northern Ireland) | 10 digits, first three 320–399 | Modulus 11 | |
| OHIP (Ontario) | 10 digits + optional 2-letter version code | Luhn on the 10 digits | version code dropped before storage |
| BC PHN | 10 digits, leading 9 | Modulus 11, weights 2,4,8,5,10,9,7,3 | |

## Normalisation
1. Strip spaces, hyphens, dots, slashes and non-breaking spaces (U+00A0).
2. Fix OCR substitutions **only in digit positions**: O/o→0, I/l/|→1, S→5, B→8, Z→2. Log each fix with `ocr_fix=1`.
3. Reject if the length is wrong after step 2. Never pad with zeros.
4. Masked values such as `*** *** 1234` or `XXXX-XXX-123-AB` go to the `pid_masked` table, not `pid_invalid`.
5. Placeholder values (`0000000000`, `1234567890`, `9999999999`) are treated as missing.

## Known failure modes (September 2026 run)
- 0.42% of GP extract rows failed the check digit; 71% of those were adjacent-digit transpositions.
- Referrals feed: 1,180 rows had the NHS number split over two lines by the PDF converter (fixed in v3.1, see DQ-1144).
- 38 rows from site CA-02 carried a version code in the health-number column (e.g. `nnnnnnnnnnAB`).

## Escalation
Raise a ticket on the DQ board (component `pid`), e.g. DQ-1182, and tag ⟦username|@farah.iqbal⟧ or the on-call engineer. Code lives in `/srv/etl/pid-validate/`; personal scratch copies under `/home/⟦username|fiqbal⟧/pid-scratch/` must never contain real extracts.

- v3.1 (2026-06-12, ⟦name|Gareth Pryce-Jones⟧): position-aware OCR mapping; line-split repair.
